RCA (rebar-debug fast path; Step-7 sibling of 3d57-602f-0b75-48ee).

MECHANISM (confirmed at runtime): child_closure_findings loops a parent's direct children and calls compute_validity(sig, c, 'completion-verifier') per closed child (src/rebar/llm/completion_child_gate.py). The completion branch (plan_review/attest.py:568-574) recomputes current_material_fingerprint -> live_material_children -> list_tickets(parent=...) -> reduce_all_tickets (1 full-store scan); a stale fingerprint retries 3 legacy generations (_legacy_material_ok) and explain_material_change enumerates once more = 5 full-store scans per stale child. Runtime proof via counting seam on reads.reduce_all_tickets: 6 scans for 1 child vs 21 for 4 children (RED test tests/unit/test_completion_child_gate_scan_count.py, exact 5/child slope as predicted).

FIX: same remedy shape as 3d57 (commit 14aa285f963) — wrap the per-child loop in the ContextVar-scoped, lazily-built, idempotent material_child_index snapshot; every live_material_children call inside (current + legacy fingerprints + material_diff explanation) answers from one wide scan. GREEN: scans constant in child count; verdict-correctness guards (true-fingerprint child stays certified, stale child lands uncertified, unclosed child still blocks) pass. Mutation check: fix reverted -> test RED again (21 vs 6), restored -> GREEN.

ATTRIBUTION (differs from 3d57's caused_by cb6b-24b4-1056-4ee6 — verified, not assumed): git log -S shows commit 66f0220d747 (epic dark-acme-lumen PR #98, pre-Gerrit, no trailer) introduced BOTH halves at once — the per-child compute_validity call in _child_closure_findings AND the completion branch's material-fingerprint recompute. cb6b (dcf41e78234) only surfaced pin health and never touched this site. The story that scoped the gate migration + validity-on-read is 929e-1971-6ad5-4fad (head-relic-twine, 'Gate migration + reopen-aware completion validity'), so caused_by = 929e-1971-6ad5-4fad; class = plan_defect (the O(N) full-store cost shipped with the design of the validity-on-read gate loop, not as a later regression of working behavior... the behavior was never fast).

SIBLING SWEEP (Step 7): construct sweep over compute_validity/current_material_fingerprint call sites found ONE remaining per-item loop outside a snapshot: orchestrator.delivered_children_manifest (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/orchestrator.py:151) loops children through delivered_now -> _attested_delivered -> compute_validity('completion-verifier') per closed child. Filing as a separate ticket linked discovered_from (same pattern 3d57 used to file this bug). All other call sites are single-shot (sidecar, remediation_mode, completion_banking, opcert jobs, transition_close, verify_opcert) or already inside a snapshot (audit/read.py, derive_plan_material_pin_health).
